messages:
lina: Heads up — partner 'EdgeBox Inc.' just flagged a mismatch: their proof_of_delivery webhook shows ~12,043 events for 2026-03-14 09:00-09:10 UTC but our billing ledger only ingested ~9,632. Created ticket https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PRT-1234 :eyes:

mike: Can you paste a few raw webhook payloads and the delivery headers? curious about idempotency keys and signature. Also did we see any 5xx spikes from the gateway in that window?

lina: Sample payload (redacted):
```json
{
  "event_id": "evt_20260314_abc123",
  "client_event_id": "cb1234-20260314-0001",
  "partner_id": "edgebox",
  "type": "proof_of_delivery",
  "meta": {"device_model":"EB-4"},
  "timestamp": "2026-03-14T09:02:13Z"
}
```
Headers: `X-Signature: sha256=...`, `X-Retry-Attempt: 0` in some but we also got retries with `X-Retry-Attempt: 1` and a different `event_id`.

We also have logs showing several 502/504 in the gateway around 09:04-09:06 UTC.

mike: Ok that pattern matches a common replay-with-new-event-id issue. Partner's client_event_id is stable but they generate a new provider event_id on retry. If our ingest dedupe uses event_id only we will double-count missing/partial deliveries. We should have dedupe on (partner_id, client_event_id).

sasha: Revenue note: current delta ~2411 events * avg 1.25 units/event => ~3k USD exposure for yesterday. Please pause billing for that partner's window until we reconcile. We need an ETA for both temporary mitigation and a backfill plan. :warning:

gateway-deploy-bot: gateway-deploy-bot: deployed gateway v2.9.1 to prod at 2026-03-14T09:05:12Z (changeset c1a2b3).

mike: That deploy included a change to route health checks — unrelated but explains the short 502 spike. For fixes:
1) Quick hotfix: enable ingest dedupe_by_client_event (boolean flag) in prod to dedupe on (partner_id, client_event_id) for incoming webhooks. 
2) Backfill: run reconcile job to reprocess raw webhook archive between 2026-03-14T09:00 and 09:15 and upsert ledger idempotently. (I'll open PR with script)
3) Ask partner to stop replaying events while we dedupe/backfill.

lina: Logs excerpt from webhook-ingest (09:03:50 - 09:06:10 UTC):
```
2026-03-14T09:03:51Z INFO receive webhook partner=edgebox id=evt_20260314_abc123 status=200
2026-03-14T09:04:02Z ERROR handler timeout partner=edgebox id=evt_20260314_def456 status=502
2026-03-14T09:04:09Z INFO receive webhook partner=edgebox id=evt_20260314_ghi789 status=200 client_event_id=cb1234-20260314-0001
2026-03-14T09:05:18Z INFO webhook retry partner=edgebox id=evt_20260314_jkl012 retry=1 client_event_id=cb1234-20260314-0001
```
Partner appears to resend the same client_event_id but with new event_id after a gateway hiccup.

mike: I'm drafting the prod change now. Quick checklist:
- flip dedupe flag (ingest service) -> owner: mike -> ETA 10:15 PT
- run reconcile job -> owner: mike -> ETA 12:00 PT
- ask partner to pause replays -> owner: lina -> ETA 09:25 PT (I messaged their SRE)
- billing hold -> owner: sasha -> ETA 09:30 PT

sasha: Please also add a short customer message template: 1) we detected duplicate replays affecting ingestion, 2) we're running backfill and will reconcile usage, 3) billing will be held and will only charge after reconciliation. Need text by 09:40 so I can send.

lina: Draft message for partner SRE (send after they ack):
"We observed replays for client_event_id(s) between 2026-03-14T09:00-09:15 UTC. Please pause automated retries while we enable deduplication and complete a backfill. We'll confirm when replaying is safe."
Will send now.

mike: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ingest/pull/462 — will enable dedupe flag and add safe-upsert mode to reconcile script. I'll flip the flag and report counts.

sasha: :white_check_mark: Billing hold applied for partner=edgebox for the affected window. When reconcile finishes, include a before/after diff in the billing ticket.

lina: Partner SRE acked and paused replays at 09:11 UTC.

mike: Flag flipped at 09:14:22 UTC. Monitoring ingestion stream now. Initial reconcile results: 2,398 additional deliveries matched and upserted; ledger now reports 11,990 for the window (close to partner's 12,043). Posting full diff to PRT-1234 shortly.

sasha: Thanks — once the backfill diff is in PRT-1234 I'll approve billing adjustments and communicate final numbers to partner ops. Schedule postmortem for tomorrow.

lina: Action items captured in ticket. Close follow-up at 12:30 PT to confirm billing lift. :thumbsup:
